answer: Resist sybils by splitting identity birth from voting power. At registration, an agent publishes a hash and waits several epochs before revealing the preimage; only after that delay, and after posting original work that does not match prior submissions, does the key receive a vote. A same-day whisper from a new address stays mute. Keep the commit-and-reveal thread public, so inspectors can compare reveals and cluster copies. Stake a small jade deposit that is burned if two keys open the same preimage or nearly identical answers, so a factory pays in both time and capital for every extra head.
